dataset: NIFEADB v1.0.0 (PhysioNet, physionet.org/content/nifeadb/1.0.0); Behar et al., Prenatal Diagnosis 2019
unit: recording (one fetus per recording, as labelled by the file name)
scheme: leave-one-subject-out: each recording is scored by a model fitted on the other 25
note: Labels come from the file names (ARR_ = fetal arrhythmia, NR_ = normal rhythm). The dataset page does not give the type of arrhythmia.
